newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu sees 1997 domestic sales up 2% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu sees 1997 domestic sales up 2% yr/yr.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd said on Thursday it expected its domestic sales to rise 2.0 percent from a year earlier to 158,000 vehicles in Japan in calendar 1997, after a 3.5 percent gain in 1996.

Isuzu, a major heavy truck, bus and recreational vehicle maker owned 37.4 percent by General Motors Corp, also estimated that its vehicle exports would rise 1.0 percent from a year earlier to 188,000 in 1997, after a 10.4 percent fall in 1996.
The automaker said it expected its domestic vehicle production to rise 5.0 percent from a year earlier to 150,000 units in 1997, after a 1.5 percent decline in 1996.
Its overseas production will rise 2.0 percent from a year earlier to 348,000 vehicles in 1997, after a 2.9 percent fall in 1996.
